content: A wet wipe, also referred to as a wet nap or moist towelette, is a small piece of paper or cloth that has been pre-moistened. It is typically folded and individually packaged in its own wrapper for ease of use, similar to the packaging of a sugar packet or a condom. These towelettes are designed for purposes such as cleansing or disinfecting. Cleansing wipes are usually infused with scented water, whereas disinfecting wipes are saturated with alcohol to provide antimicrobial properties. Wet wipes are commonly distributed in various settings, including restaurants, service stations, alongside in-flight meals, in medical offices, and other similar environments. They are frequently included as part of a sealed cutlery set for convenience. Additionally, wet wipes are widely available for personal use and can be purchased in retail stores. In Southeast Asia, wet wipes are often stored and sold in refrigerators to provide a cooling and refreshing sensation upon use.
